notes.subject: הן
notes.rationale: Hebrew particle of pointing; rendered as the Bambara exclamation 'Ne!'

notes.subject: timinandɛ
notes.rationale: תם is 'complete/blameless' — 'timinandɛ' keeps the moral-whole sense

notes.subject: יחזיק ביד
notes.rationale: 'take hold of the hand' — KJV 'help', ASV/JPS 'uphold', Geneva 'take by the hand'; rendered 'make their hand strong' literally

notes.subject: minnu bɛ jurumu kɛ
notes.rationale: participle expanded into relative clause; Hebrew has one word מרעים

translation: Ne! El ma tɛna ⟨את⟩ timinandɛ bɔ, ani a tɛna mɔgɔ minnu bɛ jurumu kɛ u bolo sembali kɛ.
